author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
translation: With the knowledge of the greatness of the Lord and devotion to Him, whatever is done as His worship or as one's own duty, becomes highly righteous; and the highest virtue to be practised by the Kshatrias is the chastisement of the haters of Narayana and their followers. To Arjuna who out of love for his kinsmen regards that duty as something unrighteous, Sri Krishna intends in the whole of the Cita Sâstra to show clearly that his highest duty is of the aforesaid description and everything in contravention of it becomes violation of duty. Now to begin with the Lord points out that his grief proceeds from lack of judgement.
